description: Capture a logcat snapshot. Supports tag filtering, priority levels, and grep patterns.

grep.description: Grep filter applied to output (literal string match, case-insensitive)

lines.description: Number of recent lines to capture (1-10000)

priority.description: Minimum priority: V(erbose), D(ebug), I(nfo), W(arn), E(rror), F(atal)

result_handle.description: Optional. If provided, store this tool's result under `result://<tool>/<name>` for retrieval after compaction. Name must be 1-32 chars, [a-zA-Z0-9_-]. Existing handles with the same tool+name are overwritten. Use adb_result_list to see active handles, adb_result_get or the MCP Resource URI to retrieve.

result_handle_ttl.description: Optional. TTL in seconds for the result handle (60 to 604800). Default 43200 (12 hours). Ignored if result_handle is not provided.

name: adb_logcat
